skill.name: linear-milestones-write
skill.description: Create and modify Linear project milestones through documented Bun CLI commands.
skill.summary: Manage Linear milestone names, descriptions, and target dates from an AI-assisted CLI workflow.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick and Bun URL detections are documentation syntax, not runtime execution or network requests. Credential and .env access are genuine risks, while missing executables and ambiguous project matching prevent complete assurance for write operations.

remediation.issue: The skill requires a Linear API credential and recommends a repository .env file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a secret manager or exported environment variable, require a narrowly scoped key, and never print or persist the credential.

remediation.issue: The referenced JavaScript and TypeScript write executables are absent from the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Include every referenced executable and dependency lockfile so reviewers can verify endpoints, input handling, credential use, and write behavior.

remediation.issue: Case-insensitive partial project matching can select an unintended write target.
remediation.suggestion: Reject ambiguous matches and require an exact project UUID or explicit confirmation before creating a milestone.

content.value_statement: Managing Linear milestones manually slows release planning and creates inconsistent records. This skill provides guided CLI commands for creating and updating milestones.
actual_capabilities: Creates Linear project milestones using a name and project name or UUID.
Adds optional descriptions and target dates during milestone creation.
Updates milestone names, descriptions, and target dates using milestone UUIDs.
Supports case-insensitive partial matching for project names.
Provides machine-readable output through the JSON flag and command details through the help flag.
limitations: Requires Bun and a LINEAR_API_KEY with permission to modify the target workspace.
The audited package does not include the referenced executable files.
Updates require an existing milestone UUID from a separate listing tool.
Partial project matching can be ambiguous and should be confirmed before creating a milestone.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Releases
use_cases.description: Create named milestones with dates and descriptions for upcoming product releases.

use_cases.title: Adjust Delivery Dates
use_cases.description: Update an existing milestone when release scope or scheduling changes.

use_cases.title: Automate Milestone Workflows
use_cases.description: Request machine-readable results for milestone creation and update tasks in controlled automation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Milestone
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear milestone named [milestone name] in project [project name or UUID]. Confirm the matched project before writing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one milestone with only required details.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Dated Milestone
prompt_templates.prompt: Create milestone [name] in project [project] with description [description] and target date [YYYY-MM-DD]. Show the result without exposing credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a fully described release milestone.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Milestone
prompt_templates.prompt: Update milestone [milestone UUID] with name [name], description [description], and target date [YYYY-MM-DD]. Summarize the changed fields.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a Verified Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate milestone UUID [UUID] and proposed values before updating. Apply only confirmed changes, request machine-readable output, and report validation failures clearly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a controlled update for an automated workflow.

output_examples.input: Create Alpha Release in the Mobile App project with target date 2026-09-30.
output_examples.output: Created the Alpha Release milestone in Mobile App with target date September 30, 2026.

output_examples.input: Rename milestone 8c43 to General Availability and move its target date to 2026-11-15.
output_examples.output: Updated milestone 8c43. The name is General Availability, and the target date is November 15, 2026.

best_practices: Use exact project UUIDs when multiple project names may match.
Review the milestone identifier and proposed changes before every write operation.
Store LINEAR_API_KEY in a secret manager or protected environment variable.
anti_patterns: Do not place LINEAR_API_KEY in prompts, logs, command history, or repository files.
Do not rely on partial project matching when several projects have similar names.
Do not run write commands until the referenced executables have been reviewed and installed.

faq.question: What can this skill change in Linear?
faq.answer: It documents commands to create milestones and update their names, descriptions, or target dates.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A LINEAR_API_KEY with permission to modify milestones in the target workspace is required.

faq.question: Can I select a project by name?
faq.answer: Yes. Project names support case-insensitive partial matching, but exact UUIDs reduce ambiguity.

faq.question: How do I update a milestone?
faq.answer: Provide the milestone UUID and at least one new value, such as its name, description, or target date.

faq.question: Does the skill support automation output?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented JSON flag requests machine-readable output from create and update commands.

faq.question: Are the executable files included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package references JavaScript and TypeScript executables that are not present, so their behavior cannot be verified.
